question: Please calculate the growth rates for Asians, Black people, Latinx people, Native Americans, White people, US women, US men, global women, and global men from 2014 to 2024 concerning the overall workforce.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
),
y2014 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
y2022 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y2022.race_asian - y2014.race_asian) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_percentage_points
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_black - y2014.race_black) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_hispanic_latinx - y2014.race_hispanic_latinx) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native Americans',
  ROUND((y2022.race_native_american - y2014.race_native_american) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_white - y2014.race_white) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_us_women - y2014.gender_us_women) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US men',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_us_men - y2014.gender_us_men) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global women',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_global_women - y2014.gender_global_women) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global men',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_global_men - y2014.gender_global_men) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
